zh.what: 实现 HNSW 算法的轻量向量检索库（C++ 编写，带 Python 接口），在大量向量中快速找出最相似的几个。
zh.before: 逐个计算距离做暴力搜索，数据一多就很慢。

en.what: A lightweight C++ library with Python bindings implementing HNSW, an algorithm for quickly finding the most similar vectors among many.
en.before: Brute-force search computing the distance to every vector, which gets slow as data grows.
